triples.quote: Fyodor Pavlovitch, who first came into contact with Grushenka over a piece of speculation, ended to his own surprise by falling madly in love with her

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Of late, when Dmitri too had come on the scene with his love, the old man left off laughing.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: although many in our town knew of the grotesque and monstrous rivalry of the Karamazovs, father and son, the object of which was Grushenka

triples.quote: I am afraid of your brother Mitya to-day, Alyosha.

triples.quote: her granddaughter, a smart young girl of twenty, who performed the duties of a maid.

triples.quote: she received Dmitri Fyodorovitch simply from fear because “he threatened to murder her.”

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: His elder died to-day, Father Zossima, the saint.

triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: Fenya, Fenya, bring us the bottle Mitya left! Look sharp!

triples.quote: I did insult her dreadfully. She sent for me, she wanted to make a conquest of me

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: don’t remind me of Dmitri Fyodorovitch, he has bruised my heart.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: You see, I love him with all my soul, that’s how it is! Alyosha, do you believe I love you with all my soul?

triples.quote: I used to hear it when I was a child from Matryona, my cook, who is still with me.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Take it. Rakitin, I owe it you, there’s no fear of your refusing it, you asked for it yourself.

triples.subject: Mihail Osipovitch Rakitin
triples.quote: He put the twenty-five rouble note in his pocket and he felt ashamed at Alyosha’s seeing it.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: And you hush, Rakitin, because you are telling lies.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: Why, are you in love with her? Agrafena Alexandrovna, our monk’s really in love with you, you’ve made a conquest!”

triples.quote: our monk’s really in love with you, you’ve made a conquest!” he cried, with a coarse laugh.

triples.quote: Alyosha, give my greetings to your brother Mitya and tell him not to remember evil against me

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Hush, evil tongue!” Grushenka cried angrily at him; “you never said such words to me as he has come to say.”

triples.quote: Damnation take you all and each of you!” he cried suddenly, “why the devil did I take you up? I don’t want to know you from this time forward.
